instruction:
One Storey Library Annex IFC

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a Revit library annex with a sloped roof and save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 5 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, and 1 IfcRoof.
5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcDoor entities, at least 6 IfcWindow entities, and at least 1 IfcOpeningElement.
6. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the tokens lobby, reading, stacks, office, and restroom at least once each.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding-box X span is between 18.0 m and 22.0 m.
9. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Y span is between 10.5 m and 13.5 m.
10. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Z span is between 3.5 m and 5.5 m.
11. The single IfcRoof shaped-geometry Z range is at least 0.8 m.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
